Title: Need to resolve Mahadayi and Kalasa Banduri water dispute. 

SHRI SURESH C. ANGADI (BELAGAVI): Madam, there is a 40 year dispute concerning water resources in my district, Mahadayi and Kalasa-Banduri. Through you, Madam, I would like to make a request to the hon. Opposition Leader, Shri Mallikarjun Kharge, Shri Veerappa Moily, senior leader of the Congress, and the UPA Chairperson also. To resolve this small issue, the Opposition leaders of Goa and Maharashtra are willing to cooperate. The hon. Prime Minister is very much interested to resolve this issue out of court. The matter is in the Tribunal. Since last six months, people are on strike in my area in Navalagunda and Naragunda. Especially in my area, Bailahongala, tomorrow will be the 100 days of sitting on strike on the water issue. This is creating a severe problem for irrigation and drinking water. Never such a magnitude of drought had happened in 90 years. For the first time in 90 years, we are facing a very high magnitude of drought situation in the country…. * 

माननीय अध्यक्ष : सीएम के लिए कोई एलीगेशन रिकार्ड में नहीं जाएगा।

You can make a request. 

SHRI SURESH C. ANGADI: When he came to meet the Prime Minister in Delhi, we requested him to settle the matter out of court, and to have cordial relationship. I would like to request the UPA Chairperson and other leaders concerned to rise above parties, leave the differences for people’s sake. I would request all the leaders of Karnataka, Maharashtra and Goa to resolve the issue.
